module: "Direction arrow" checkpoint marker: a floating arrow (s_mm_arrow_floating.dae) oriented according to the checkpoint's rotation, with a slight back-and-forth along its forward axis. Its color follows core_groundMarkers.floatingArrowColor (blue 0, 0.4, 1 by default). The module returns a constructor: require('scenario/raceMarkers/directionMarker')(id) gives an object of class C.
notes: setToCheckpoint(wp) requires wp.pos; wp.rot (quaternion as a table or x,y,z,w userdata) gives the orientation, wp.radius the scale (3 by default). Without wp.pos, the call is ignored.
Back-and-forth amplitude: 0.08 m, frequency tied to os.clock()*3.
The mode has no visual effect: only 'hidden' hides, the other modes show.

update.desc: Per-frame call: applies position (with back-and-forth), rotation and scale to the arrow.

setToCheckpoint.desc: Places the arrow on a checkpoint and applies the color.

setMode.desc: 'hidden' hides, other mode shows; remembers the mode.

createObject.desc: Creates a hidden TSStatic (with instanceColor and instanceColor1) registered under objectName and added to ScenarioObjectsGroup.

createMarkers.desc: Removes the old objects then creates the arrow.
